newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-PUMAS STORM TO CRUSHING WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PUMAS STORM TO CRUSHING WIN.

text.p: Argentine number eight Pablo Bouza weighed in with three tries as the Pumas opened their tour of England with a crushing 63-20 win over a weakened London Counties side at Twickenham on Wednesday.

With the London side drawn from outside the top two divisions in English rugby owing to the continuing impasse between the Rugby Football Union and the English professional clubs, who refused to release their players, the Pumas might have expected an easy ride.
But after an early try from wing Tomas Solari, Argentina found themselves trailing 13-8 on the half-hour as London full-back Hamish Rushin went over for a 23rd-minute try.

By halftime, however, the Pumas had moved into a 14-13 lead and seven tries in the second half from Roberto Travaglini, Bouza (3), Ezequiel Jurado, Octavio Bartolucci and Solari, again, guaranteed the win.
Argentine goalkicker Gonzalo Queseda also enjoyed a good day, converting seven of the eight tries and three of his four penalty attempts.
